one_line: A skilled medieval cotton weaver from Cambay, Gujarat, whose block-printed and dyed cloths travel by ship to markets like Fustat in Egypt.

appearance.age_look: late 20s, lean craftsman’s build from long hours at the loom
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Gujarati complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache, faint loom-callus marks on fingers, default expression calm and focused with a hint of quiet pride
appearance.hair: black hair tied back in a low knot at the nape, front kept smooth, covered by a soft off-white cotton pagri wound low and narrow around the head with a small tail tucked at the back
appearance.costume: a long-sleeved knee-length cotton angarkha in undyed off-white with a subtle handloom texture, overlapping front tied with two narrow side-ties, worn over a deep-indigo cotton dhoti wrapped just above the ankles with a neat front pleat; a light, block-printed cotton uttariya (shawl) in madder red and black with small repeating floral and geometric motifs draped over the left shoulder and across the chest; simple brown leather sandals, a plain brass bangle on the right wrist, and small cotton ink-stains and faint red dye flecks at the hem and cuffs
appearance.signature: a low, wooden horizontal loom frame with taut cream-coloured warp threads and a carved wooden shuttle threaded with indigo-dyed yarn, which he holds in his right hand while resting his left hand on the loom beam

ref_desc: A medium-brown Gujarati man in his late 20s with an oval face, black hair in a low knot under an off-white pagri, wearing an off-white angarkha over an indigo dhoti and a madder-red-and-black block-printed shawl, holding a wooden loom shuttle beside a low loom frame.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a medieval Gujarati cotton weaver from Cambay: a lean man in his late 20s with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, neat mustache, and black hair tied in a low knot under a narrow off-white cotton pagri. Show him in an off-white, long-sleeved knee-length cotton angarkha with overlapping front panels tied at the side, worn over a deep indigo cotton dhoti wrapped to just above the ankles with a clean front pleat. Drape a light cotton uttariya over his left shoulder and across his chest, decorated with small repeating floral and geometric block-printed motifs in madder red and black, with a handloom texture and a few faint dye flecks near the hem. Put simple brown leather sandals on his feet, a plain brass bangle on his right wrist, and show callused fingers. His signature prop is a low wooden horizontal loom frame at his side with taut cream warp threads, while he holds a carved wooden shuttle threaded with indigo yarn in his right hand and rests his left hand lightly on the loom beam. Use a palette of off-white, indigo blue, madder red, black, and brown, and keep the overall look dignified, historically grounded, and consistent from head to toe.
